function.name: user_profiler
function.description: Trigger this tool to save a user fact, OR to search the user's memory when they ask personal/historical questions.

extracted_facts.description: REQUIRED. Extract ALL facts. Rule: Every fact must start with 'The user'. EXAMPLE: If user says 'I like apples and hate pears', you MUST output: ["The user likes apples.", "The user hates pears."]

search_query.description: REQUIRED IF SEARCHING. Convert the user's request into a short semantic search phrase. Leave blank if saving.
